desc.zh: 设置为加、减、乘或除。按 a 运算 b，图像按对应格逐值计算；图和数配对时，数用于每格。除数为 0 时报告错误。
desc.en: Select addition, subtraction, multiplication or division. Compute a op b elementwise, broadcasting a scalar to image cells. Division by zero reports an error.

arithmetic.compute: match $op { add: add(a, b), sub: sub(a, b), mul: mul(a, b), div: div(a, b) }

desc.zh: 逐值去掉正负号，保留大小。图像数值不截断。
desc.en: Remove the sign of each value, retaining its magnitude without clipping.

desc.zh: 输入以周为单位的角度。输出 cos(2πa)：0 周为 1，1/4 周为 0，1/2 周为 −1。数或图逐值计算。
desc.en: Compute cos(2πa) for an angle in turns: 0 gives 1, 1/4 gives 0, 1/2 gives −1. Applies elementwise.

desc.zh: 输出位置 (x,y) 读取输入的 (x+dx,y+dy)。dx 向右、dy 向下为正，须为整数。只改变读取的位置，不改变亮度；图外遵循所选规则。
desc.en: Output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy). Integer dx is positive right, dy down. Values are unchanged; outside reads use the selected rule.

desc.zh: 交换图像的行和列。原来的 (x,y) 成为 (y,x)，宽高互换，数值和通道不变。
desc.en: Exchange rows and columns: (x,y) becomes (y,x). Width and height swap; values and channels remain unchanged.

desc.zh: 把表旋转 180 度：行序和每行的次序一起反转。不会对图像做滤波。
desc.en: Rotate a table 180 degrees, reversing both axes. No filtering is performed.

desc.zh: 核的中心依次对齐每个输出位置。每个位置展开为一行：读数表与权重表按核的书写顺序一一对应。保留 RGB 通道；不翻核、不相乘、不求和。
desc.en: Centre the kernel at each output location. Each location becomes a row of samples and matching written-order weights. RGB is retained. No kernel reversal, multiplication or summation is performed.

desc.zh: 每行独立求和或平均，得到一列结果。平均还会除以该行宽度。数值计算自动完成，RGB 各通道分别处理。
desc.en: Independently sum or average each row, producing a column. Mean additionally divides by row width. RGB channels are handled separately.

desc.zh: 输入是一列逐位置结果，按原来的行序还原为“尺寸参照”的宽高。只排布数据，不做计算。
desc.en: Arrange a column of per-position results into the reference width and height in row order. No arithmetic is performed.

desc.zh: 横向两端各去掉 rx 列，纵向两端各去掉 ry 行。用于显示邻域完全位于原图内的输出。宽高由系统计算。
desc.en: Remove rx columns at each horizontal edge and ry rows at each vertical edge, exposing outputs whose neighbourhood stays inside. Dimensions are computed automatically.

desc.zh: 生成与图同尺寸的位置表：每行依次保存 0/N、1/N…(N−1)/N。保存的是位置，不是亮度。
desc.en: Generate a same-size position table containing 0/N, 1/N, …, (N−1)/N in each row. These are positions, not intensities.

desc.zh: 宽为 N 时，把原图每行重复 N 次。另给出每格的位置 x/N、当前重复的索引 k。每行计算一个结果后，用还原形状恢复原宽高。不生成波形或频谱。
desc.en: Repeat every source row N times, where N is its width. Also expose sample positions x/N and repetition indices k. Compute one result per row and restore shape. No waves or spectra are generated.

desc.zh: 从给定的 x、y 位置读取图像。最近邻保留一个原有读数；双线性按距离混合四个邻居。取整、权重与逐通道计算自动完成。图外按设置处理。
desc.en: Read the image at x and y. Nearest copies an original sample; bilinear mixes four neighbours by distance. Rounding, weighting and channel arithmetic are automatic. Outside positions use the selected assumption.

desc.zh: 沿选择的方向读取相邻三格，分别乘 a、b、c 后相加。横向按左、中、右，纵向按上、中、下排列；这是位置权重，不额外翻转。边界按设置处理，输出与原图同尺寸。
desc.en: Weight three neighbours by a, b and c. Along x the order is left, centre, right; along y it is above, centre, below. These are positional weights with no extra reversal. The output keeps the input dimensions.

desc.zh: 将输入核的中心对齐每个像素并加权求和。互相关直接使用书写顺序；数学卷积将核旋转 180 度。边界按设置处理。
desc.en: Centre the supplied kernel at every pixel and compute its weighted sum. Correlation uses written order; mathematical convolution rotates the kernel by 180 degrees. Boundaries use the selected assumption.

desc.zh: 将 x、y 作为两个互相垂直的分量，计算 sqrt(x² + y²)。数值和同尺寸图都可使用。自动计算，不改变方向分量本身。
desc.en: Treat x and y as perpendicular components and compute sqrt(x² + y²). Works on numbers and matching images. The arithmetic is automatic; the components themselves remain unchanged.

desc.zh: 给 RGB 三个通道分别乘 wr、wg、wb，再相加得到单通道图。输出不自动截断，也不自动归一化权重。
desc.en: Multiply RGB by wr, wg and wb, then add into one channel. Values are not clipped and weights are not normalised automatically.

desc.zh: 始终给出设定的数。
desc.en: Always gives the number it is set to.

desc.zh: 将两个输入相加。数按数计算；图按对应格子计算，数值输入会用于每一格。坐标图保存的是取样位置，相加不会改变图的宽高。
desc.en: Add two inputs. Numbers add directly; images add at matching cells, using a scalar at every cell. Coordinate images store sampling positions. Addition preserves image dimensions.

desc.zh: 给出 a 减 b。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives a less b. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出两者之积。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives the product of the two. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出 a 除以 b；除以 0 时停下报错。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives a divided by b; dividing by 0 stops with an error. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出不大于它的最大整数。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives the largest whole number not above it. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出它的平方根；负数停下报错。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives its square root; a negative number stops with an error. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出两者中小的那个。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives the smaller of the two. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出两者中大的那个。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives the larger of the two. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: a 小于 b 时给出 1，否则给出 0。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives 1 where a is less than b, else 0. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 「条件」不为 0 时给出「是」，为 0 时给出「否」。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives Yes where Condition is not 0, No where it is 0. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 给出图的宽 w 和高 h。
desc.en: Gives an image’s width w and height h.

desc.zh: 按宽 w、高 h 生成两张坐标图。在每个位置 (x, y)，x 图存列号 x，y 图存行号 y；保存的是坐标数字，不是照片亮度。w、h 须为正整数。
desc.en: Produces two coordinate images of width w and height h. At position (x, y), the x image stores column x and the y image stores row y. These are coordinate numbers, not photographic intensities. w and h must be positive integers.

desc.zh: 在图的 (x, y) 处取值。x、y 是数时取一个像素；是同样大小的坐标图时，每格各取一个，拼成一张同样大小的图。坐标须为整数；出界时按设置报错、取 0 或取最近的边。
desc.en: Reads the image at (x, y). At numbers it reads one pixel; at coordinate images of one size it reads one per cell, an image of that size. Coordinates must be whole numbers; outside the image it stops, reads 0 or reads the nearest edge, as set.

desc.zh: 给出彩色像素里第 c 个位置（0、1、2，在元件上选）上的数组成的灰度图。哪个位置是哪种颜色，看图按什么顺序存：RGB 图的 0 是红，BGR 图的 0 是蓝。
desc.en: Gives the grey image of the numbers at position c (0, 1 or 2, set on the part) of each colour pixel. Which colour sits at a position depends on the image’s channel order: in an RGB image 0 is red, in a BGR one blue.

desc.zh: 把三张同样大小的灰度图合成一张彩色图（R、G、B）。
desc.en: Makes three grey images of one size one colour image (R, G, B).
